name: truco-gaucho
description: Truco Gaúcho Online: cliente React (Vite) e servidor Node.js com Socket.IO

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint && node server/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c e2e/eslint.config.js e2e
